status_at_freeze: Downloaded sources and inspected metadata/structure only; candidate expression values not inspected.
purpose: Map five existing genetic candidates to author-annotated liver cell contexts; quantify descriptive donor-level expression and evaluability, without genetic-causality or treatment claims.
gene_mapping: Unique exact feature_name in raw/var; record its feature identifier and missing/ambiguous/filtered status. Do not replace missing genes with aliases without amendment.
count_qc: Verify every stored raw count finite, nonnegative and integer; CSR dimensions and indices valid, no duplicate cell IDs, feature IDs unique, obs/raw/X dimensions agree. Fail counts analysis on violations. Retain source normalized X without using it as UMI counts.
cell_exclusion_rules: Required donor, assay, author_cell_type or disease label is missing
annotation_policy: Use original author labels; do not infer or merge cell subtypes using candidate expression. Preserve hybrid-looking labels without -- literally and flag interpretation; no de novo clustering.
unit: donor within dataset, assay and author cell type; repeated libraries from a donor combined; sc/sn reported separately and never counted as independent replications.
raw_aggregation: Sum candidate UMIs and all-feature UMIs across retained cells of each donor/stratum. Detection fraction is count>0 cells divided by retained cells of that donor/stratum. Excluded cells do not enter denominator.
normalization: CPM=1e6*candidate_UMIs/all_feature_UMIs for each donor/stratum; log2(CPM+1). No pooling donor denominators for primary summaries.
summaries: Retained cells and total/evaluable donors per cohort, assay and author cell type
Median donor log2(CPM+1), median CPM, median donor detection fraction and observed ranges
Counts of donors with gene UMIs>0; gene non-detection distinguished from missing annotation
contrast: For each gene and author cell type within a dataset and shared assay, median PSC log2(CPM+1) minus median Control log2(CPM+1); descriptive only; no cell-level tests, significance labels, causal or treatment inference.
contrast_gates: At least3 eligible donors from each cohort in the exact same assay
Gene annotated uniquely and count QC passed
Every donor has positive all-feature count denominator
sensitivity: Repeat at50cells; leave-one-donor-out range for evaluable contrast without treating leave-outs as independent samples; report how many post-deletion contrasts still satisfy3-per-cohort gate.
missingness_policy: Enumerate every planned gene and observed author cell-type/assay combination, including exclusions, sparse groups, zeros and non-evaluable contrasts. No cross-chemistry fallback.
metadata_findings_before_counts: SC: all control cells annotated10x5primev1, allPSC/PBC annotated10x5primev2; complete condition/chemistry confounding blocks SC PSC-Control contrast.
SN: all cells annotated10x3primev3; tissue preparation differs bycohort, donor covariates are incomplete and source nuclei counts differ from paper abstract.
Cell/nucleus data share some donor labels; measure overlap exactly and report separately.
Authors retain doublet/hybrid/unknown groups in distributed objects; exclude byfixedmetadata rules.
not_in_this_phase: No spatial proximity or ETS2 program score inferred from single gene expression
No genotype, eQTL, splice-junction, protein or intervention effect estimated
No new clinical samples or researcher contact
deliverable: Complete five-gene descriptive tables, source/coverage audit, one plot and a report prioritizing only supported cell-context follow-ups; retain inconclusive candidates without forcingpositive results.
